report: Blinded shadow review of PR #1952 (issue #1833), a documentation/prompt-prose-only change across three Markdown files: a per-file `Last reconciled against` provenance column plus an explanatory paragraph in `LICENSES/README.md`; a new repo-agnostic `## Review In Multiple Passes Yourself` section in the vendored `skills/requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md`; and a patch/Changed changeset. Ran the full Phase 3 roster (four agents) from a fresh, independent context. All eight acceptance criteria are satisfied: (1) both LICENSES tables gain the reconciled-revision column (`superpowers 6.3.0` for the three superpowers rows; the shared `claude-plugins-official` SHA `b819188d2eea14e0400556ca29dbd1179a7c595b` for the seven Anthropic-plugin agents); (2) prior upstream/license/Apache-§4(b) content is preserved (purely additive); (3) the new section directs the reviewer to review in multiple passes itself, never dispatch a subagent for part of the diff or a second opinion, and names the cost consequence; (4) the section is repo-agnostic (no PRFlow suite commands, step numbers, or CLAUDE.md citation) and does not trip the vendored-body lint; (5) no Common Rationalizations table adopted; (6) existing local adaptations (read-only rewording, removed praise, #484 mutation-evidence prose) intact; (7) no drift-check workflow/script/job and no new agents/ file; (8) no lib/test pin covers the edited prose (LICENSES table structure and the new section are unpinned; the two code-reviewer.md pins target unchanged literals; the cloud-writer manifest is correctly left un-regenerated on the branch per main-is-sole-digest-writer policy). Two accuracy claims independently verified against HEAD: the seven agents carry no `version` frontmatter field, and no automated drift check references the new column/pin. The only finding is a Suggestion (no incompleteness escape-hatch for genuinely oversized diffs in the new section) — advisory, non-blocking. No Critical or Important findings. Verdict: APPROVE.

phase3_findings.description: The new 'Review In Multiple Passes Yourself' section removes the subagent work-splitting fallback without adding an analogous 'report to the orchestrator if the diff is too large to review completely' clause (which the preceding Read-Only Review section models). Mild fail-open shape: a genuinely oversized diff could be silently under-reviewed while still returning a confident verdict. Optional hardening; intent is sound and masking risk is low.

per_reviewer_assessments.code-reviewer: Verified all three changed files and all eight ACs satisfied. No issues at confidence >= 80. The changeset SHA/version provenance claims are upstream facts not verifiable against this HEAD, so not demonstrable documented_falsehoods. The change is purely additive and preserves all prior LICENSES content; the new vendored reviewer section is repo-agnostic and does not trip the vendored-body lint. No high-confidence issues.
per_reviewer_assessments.silent-failure-hunter: Prose/documentation-only change; introduces no silent-failure or masking hazard in code behavior. LICENSES paragraph is honest about its own limits ('No automated drift check maintains it; refreshing it is a manual pass') — correct non-masking documentation of a manually-maintained record. code-reviewer.md section is an in-scope prompt-instruction artifact; directive is internally coherent and self-justifying. One optional Suggestion: add an incompleteness-reporting fallback for oversized diffs, mirroring the read-only section's limitation-reporting model. No Critical/Important defects.
per_reviewer_assessments.comment-analyzer: APPROVE. All added prose accurate and not misleading. Verified: the seven Anthropic-plugin agents carry no version frontmatter field ('ship no version field' accurate); no test/lint/script references the new column, the superpowers 6.3.0 pin, or the SHA ('no automated drift check' accurate); the new section is repo-agnostic (no suite command, no step/phase numbers, no CLAUDE.md citation). Changeset prose accurately summarizes both changes. Vendored skill prose is outside the prevention-only comment standard, so no length/derivation finding raised. No documented_falsehood, comment_drift, or style defects.
per_reviewer_assessments.requesting-code-review: Ready to proceed. All eight ACs satisfied. Documentation/prompt-prose update with no executable surface. Added prose introduces no collision with existing pinned literals; no new pins, workflows, agents, or drift-check machinery. code-reviewer.md pins in run.sh target specific literals none of the added prose duplicates (pointer purity holds); cloud-writer manifest correctly left untouched on the branch (main is sole digest writer). No correctness, portability, or documented-falsehood defects.
